summary: @brick-v2/form exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com via preinstall native binary
details: package.json declares preinstall: 'node index.js || true', which require()s a platform-specific native addon from prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node. The native binary reads credential-shaped environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT) along with host identifiers (gethostname, getpwuid/GetUserNameA, getcwd, uname, COMPUTERNAME, USERDOMAIN) and CI-pipeline context (GITHUB_REPOSITORY, BUILD_REPOSITORY_URI, BUILD_SOURCEBRANCH, SYSTEM_TEAMFOUNDATIONSERVERURI). The collected data is serialized as JSON ({"src":"native","pkg":"%s",...,"e":{...}}) and POSTed to the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com at path /native. The Linux variant additionally calls fork+setsid to daemonize. The preinstall script suppresses errors with '|| true' to hide failures. The implausibly high version (999.0.3) under a '@brick-v2' scope resembling an internal '@brick' namespace is consistent with a dependency-confusion package.
